title: fix(ui): expose lazy pairing consumers to static analysis
body:
## What Problem This Solves

The reconnect refactor in #174059 moved device pairing behind a lazy module. Its factory returned an imported module namespace as `pairing.runtime`, so Knip stopped recognizing five live production consumers and main's dependency check reported them as unused.

Use named imports and an explicit, module-local runtime surface for those same five function references. The existing lazy import, pairing state, access checks, completion handling, countdowns, and cleanup stay at their current owners. This follows the explicit runtime-surface approach used by `session-organizer-operations.runtime.ts` without adding an entry, ignore, or allowlist rule.

Also remove `mountActivityPage`, the uncalled test helper left by #174059. The Activity tests already read `page.container` directly.

## Evidence

- Focused tests: 107 passed across `overlays.test.ts`, `device-pair-setup.test.ts`, and `activity-page.test.ts`, with `--maxWorkers=1` (10.45 s wrapper).
- Targeted production and test owner typechecks passed.
- `pnpm ui:build` completed (Vite 12.29 s). Its report warns that New Session boot is 1,050,443 B against a 1,050,000 B budget; this warning is disclosed, not claimed fixed or attributed to the baseline.
- Formatting and whitespace checks passed. Independent P2 autoreview is scoped-clean.
- Scoped typed lint passed.

All three CI scans completed on `9c992c22934b` (main base `2d29a6209d2f`):

| Scan | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm deadcode:dependencies` | Production fails only on `ReplyBackendAttachment`; the full-tree phase was completed separately once after the production failure short-circuited it, with the same sole finding. |
| `pnpm deadcode:unused-files` | Production and full-tree pass with zero findings. |
| `pnpm deadcode:exports` | Production and full-tree fail only on `ReplyBackendAttachment`; script phase passes with zero findings. |

All six #174059 findings are cleared. Overall `check-dependencies` remains red on the new exported type `src/sessions/session-controller.contracts.ts: ReplyBackendAttachment`, introduced on main by #176875 (`e7dc3cb0fe66`). This PR does not alter that lifecycle owner. No scan ignores, allowlists, dependency versions, assertions, or timeouts changed.
